mechanics.summary: Blizzard announced a 30% reduction to health and damage of all Firelands bosses and other enemies, via Power of Stormrage, with optional removal by General Taldris Moonfall.
Current guides report Shannox appearing after enough trash and patrolling a circular front-area route; the local instance has no activation threshold or patrol handler.

values.patrol_route: circular front Firelands area per guide

mechanics.summary: Too much distance between Shannox and pets applies a 4-second 100% damage/attack-speed enrage; current guide reports 60 yards normal and 80 heroic.
Shannox's spear-bearing melee replacement is a 125% frontal cone applying stacking Jagged Tear; local and guide cadences differ.
Hurl Spear creates the tank reset window and fire eruptions; when Riplimb is dead the local script substitutes Magma Rupture.
Shannox throws Immolation and Crystal Prison traps at random players; local trap AI arms after 2 seconds and triggers on nearby dogs/player.
Riplimb is a taunt-immune tanked pet that applies Jagged Tear and is reported to fetch the spear after Hurl Spear.

values.spear_fetch: guide-described; no explicit local movement handler
values.dogged_determination: guide-described movement slow floor/acceleration; spell ID not frozen
values.wary: guide-described trap immunity after dog trap; local aura absent

mechanics.summary: Rageface has no normal threat table, switches random victims, and periodically channels Face Rage until a large hit breaks it.
Pet deaths increase Shannox pressure; normal sources require both dogs dead before 30%, while current heroic guidance describes no 30% dog enrage and possible Rageface resurrection.

values.frenzy_current_wowhead: +40% attack speed/+25% Physical damage for5m per dog, stacks

lifecycle.activation: Guide-described trash threshold/patrol; no local threshold/controller event.
lifecycle.engage: Local boss engages both dogs and schedules encounter events.
lifecycle.reset: Local Reset clears Frenzy state and disengages; EnterEvade tells dogs to evade, moves boss home, despawns summons, and calls _DespawnAtEvade.
lifecycle.death: Local JustDied calls generic _JustDied, disengages, despawns summons, and asks both dogs to despawn after 5 seconds.
lifecycle.phase: No local 30% health phase handler; pet death branches Hurl to local Magma Rupture and generic Berserk after two deaths.
lifecycle.unlock: No local Shannox unlock branch; guide says enough trash activates patrol.
lifecycle.completion_credit: Generic instance boss-state/encounter framework only; retail loot, lockout, achievement, and recipient semantics unresolved.
